after3_start.name: {name}
after3_start.text: *After school, I stop at the corridor junction in the sunset. I look up at the signs for the student council room, library annex and gym that I have passed for three days, then adjust the bag strap on my shoulder.*

after3_route_check.name: {name}
after3_route_check.text: *I fidget with the phone in my pocket. To settle this tangle of weekend plans, who should I go find first after school today?*

after3_auto_dain.name: {name}
after3_auto_dain.text: *Dain's right foot keeps coming back to me, half a beat late as she followed along at the school gate this morning. I head for the gym.*

after3_auto_yuna.name: {name}
after3_auto_yuna.text: *Yuna's fingertips come back to me, fidgeting with nothing but a bookmark, silent all through lunch. I head for the library annex.*

after3_auto_seo.name: {name}
after3_auto_seo.text: *Seoyeon's eyes stay with me, clipboard gripped tight while she forced herself to look fine. I climb the stairs toward the student council room.*

after3_multi_choice.name: {name}
after3_multi_choice.text: *I can't leave these overlapping weekend plans hanging. Right now, who do I go find first and bring it up with?*
choices: Go to Seoyeon
Go to Yuna
Go to Dain
Think a little more

after3_choice.name: {name}
after3_choice.text: *The end of the hall is dyed in sunset. Which way do I walk?*
choices: To the student council room
To the library
To the gym
Just go home today

after3_reject_for_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_1.text: *Around the hallway corner, Dain doesn't wave first the way she usually does. She only scrapes the floor tiles with the toe of her sneaker.*

after3_reject_for_seo_2.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_seo_2.text: *Dain glances at the stairs toward the student council room, the way my eyes went.* You're not coming to the gym after school today, are you?

after3_reject_for_seo_3.name: Yuna
after3_reject_for_seo_3.text: *At Yuna's seat in the library annex, only a note folded into a square is left. I never even got the words out about sorting our plans.* I'll head out first today.

after3_reject_for_seo_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_4.text: *I'm back out in the hall. Dain's voice had sunk low, and Yuna's seat was cold and empty. The note clenched in my hand crumples along its folds.*

after3_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_1.text: *When I open the student council room door, Seoyeon is slumped over the sunset-lit desk, her head resting on her arms. The clipboard she always carries lies at her feet.*

after3_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_3.text: *Startled by the sound of the door, Seoyeon sits up. The ribbon is slightly undone, and mascara is smeared faintly under her flushed eyes.*

after3_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_4.text: *Avoiding my eyes, Seoyeon pushes the fallen clipboard under the desk's shadow with the toe of her shoe.*

after3_seo_5_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_5_b.text: *Seoyeon brushes her messy bangs down with trembling fingers and asks in a wet voice.* Just now. Did you see all of it?

after3_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_6.text: *Seoyeon gives a small cough, trying to steady the breath caught in her throat.* It's nothing. Just forget what you saw.

after3_seo_7.name: {name}
after3_seo_7.text: What are you saying I saw?

after3_seo_7_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_7_b.text: *Seoyeon takes half a step toward me, then stops and presses the back of her hand against her eyes.* Of all people, you. I never wanted you to see my face fallen apart like this.

after3_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_8.text: *Past wet lashes, the eyes looking up at me waver.* Don't tell anyone what I looked like today. Keep it a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_9.text: Give me a second to catch my breath. *Seoyeon bites her lip hard and, with a trembling hand, picks up the clipboard and sets it on her lap.*

after3_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice.text: Leave what you saw today here. Instead, in this room, right now, could you treat me like usual, as if nothing happened?
choices: Everyone has days like this. Don't take it so hard.
Just now? I didn't see anything. I dropped my pen and came in to pick it up.
I’ll understand even the weak side of you.
From now on, I’ll stay beside you and take care of everything.

after3_seo_pity_trap_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_1.text: *Seoyeon's shoulders lock stiff. She scrubs the smeared skin around her eyes with the back of her hand until it goes red.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_3.text: *Seoyeon's voice splits, cold.* That thing you just said. You offered it to me as comfort?

after3_seo_pity_trap_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_4.text: Don't look down at me with those eyes. *Seoyeon whips her head aside and wipes her eyes again with the back of her hand.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_5.text: Don't brush this off like some light thing everyone goes through. I'm not in any shape right now to be fine from one obvious line like that.

after3_seo_pity_trap_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_6.text: I wasn't hiding because I wanted pity. I don't want to hear any more right now. *Seoyeon turns away, drawing her collar closed. A black streak of makeup is smeared across the back of her hand.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_7.text: Could you just leave? I still have to finish the student council accounts.

after3_seo_pity_trap_9.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_9.text: *Seoyeon cuts me off with ice-cold eyes.* At school, President. Call me that.

after3_seo_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_10.text: *I shut the student council room door like I'd been chased out. Through the empty hall, one sound: the clipboard thrown cold onto the desk.*

after3_seo_correct_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_1.text: *The knuckles gripping the edge of the clipboard go white. Seoyeon holds her breath and waits for what I'll say next.*

after3_seo_correct_2.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_2.text: *I bend down and reach under the desk. To give Seoyeon time to dry her eyes, I look at the floor and fumble around as if searching for a pen.*

after3_seo_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_3.text: Oh, it rolled under here. So even with the president in the room, is the council room just a place where pens keep evaporating?

after3_seo_correct_4.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_4.text: *I straighten up slowly and step in close to the arm of Seoyeon's chair. A faint stain is left on the back of her pale hand, where she wiped the makeup.*

after3_seo_correct_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_5.text: *Seoyeon catches a short breath, then matches my tone and steadies her voice.* Pens vanishing from the council room is a real mystery. A good 30 a year disappear without a trace.

after3_seo_correct_6.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_6.text: So the great student council president still hasn't caught that culprit?

after3_seo_correct_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_7.text: *A low laugh finally slips out between Seoyeon's lips.* If I hunted down every single pen, the kids would be way too scared of the council.

after3_seo_correct_8.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_8.text: So where are all those pens even hiding? *I keep the dumb jokes going, perch on the corner of the desk, and stay beside her until her breathing settles.*

after3_seo_correct_9.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_9.text: *Seoyeon looks up at me, her eyes warmer now, and lightly catches the end of my uniform sleeve in her fingers.* {name}.

after3_seo_correct_11.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_11.text: *Seoyeon lowers her head until her forehead nearly touches my forearm and whispers. Hot breath brushes through the open shirt collar.* Next time you lose a pen, come here first.

after3_seo_correct_12.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_12.text: *Seoyeon folds next week's student council duty sheet, still warm from her hands, and quietly slides it onto my palm.*

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *Seoyeon sets the clipboard aside on the desk and pulls the chair right beside her in close.* If nothing's urgent, stay next to me a little longer. I don't want to be left alone right now.
after3_seo_freetalk.context: On the third afternoon, they are sitting together in the student council room. Instead of questioning Seoyeon about her tears, the player pretended to retrieve a pen and joked as usual. She offered next week’s schedule in gratitude. This scene deepened trust. Refer to separate appointment conflicts only if established by flags or memories.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is relieved that her dignity was respected. Her dry, brief humor returns and she makes room for the player. She does not immediately reveal every reason she was crying.

after3_reject_for_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_1.text: *By the hallway window, Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard. The hands turning the pages are unusually fast, and dry.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_yuna_2.text: I've still got council closing work. Don't wait. Head out first today.

after3_reject_for_yuna_3.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_yuna_3.text: *Through the gap in the open gym door, I see Dain alone on the empty court, practicing her serve.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.text: *At Dain's bright hello, I only lift a hand, awkward, and look away. The palm in my pocket sinks, heavy.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_4.text: *From Seoyeon I only heard about work, and with Dain I only left a short hello. The plans I actually needed to sort out never made it out of my mouth.*

after3_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_1.text: *I stop in a corner of the library annex, in front of the reading space that's Yuna's alone. The wooden door, always shut, is half open today of all days.*

after3_yuna_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_2.text: *Yuna isn't on the sofa. Only an old leather notebook lies open on the cushion. Neat handwriting fills the pages under Yuna's name.*

after3_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_yuna_4.text: *My eyes hit the first page without meaning to. "One day a transfer student came. He found his way to the corner of the library and sat beside me without a word. I didn't mind that warmth."*

after3_yuna_5_b.name: {name}
after3_yuna_5_b.text: *Right under that sentence, the phrase "gazes that overlapped by the classroom window" is underlined twice in pale purple ink.*

after3_yuna_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_6.text: *A low, cold voice comes from behind me.* What are you doing there?

after3_yuna_7.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_7.text: I got a drink for you. Why are you looking down at that? *Yuna stops in the doorway. Her eyes lock between my fingertips and the notebook.*

after3_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_8b.text: *Yuna closes the distance in one move and snatches the notebook out of my hand.* I haven't said you can read it yet.

after3_yuna_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_9.text: I brought it so I could hand it to you myself. I'm not ready yet. *Yuna clutches the notebook and grips my wrist. Her earlobe flares bright red.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice.text: *The fingertips holding my wrist tremble in small shakes. The purple eyes right in front of me waver.*
choices: I'm sorry. But this is about me, isn't it?
I'm sorry. I only saw the open first page. I won't read any more. But this writer's prose is really good.
Don’t worry. I’ll keep this notebook safe for you.
From now on, show this kind of writing only to me.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.text: *Yuna shakes my wrist off and pulls the leather notebook tight against her chest. Her fingers press hard enough to crease the cover.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.text: What do you mean, it isn't. The first line says a transfer student, and reading by the classroom window is exactly us.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_4.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_4.text: *Yuna's voice rips sharp.* I told you it isn't.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.text: I'm telling you myself it isn't, and if you're still going to decide that on your own, I have nothing else to say. *Yuna shoves the notebook into the deepest part of her bag and pulls the zipper shut all the way.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.text: It's people who dig in pretending they know everything inside you. That's why I can't write a single line in peace.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.text: If real life wasn't enough, and you pull back even what I hid behind a line of fiction, where am I supposed to hide?

after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.text: I can't listen to your voice anymore right now. *Yuna shoulders her bag, brushes my shoulder cold, and walks to the door.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.text: This room. From today, I'm keeping the door locked.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.text: *Yuna's footsteps echo down the hall and fade fast. On the empty sofa, only the pressed mark where the notebook sat, and a drink can going cold, are left.*

after3_yuna_correct_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_1.text: *The strength slowly leaves Yuna's fingers, the ones clutching the notebook like she was guarding it.*

after3_yuna_correct_2.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_2.text: *Yuna blinks and asks again, low.* This writer?

after3_yuna_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_3.text: Yeah. It's a notebook you copied out by hand, right? Which writer's novel is it? Looks like it hasn't been officially published.

after3_yuna_correct_4.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_4.text: *Yuna doesn't look away. The corner of her mouth lifts, just a little.* Who knows. Probably an unpublished manuscript. The only copy in the world.

after3_yuna_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_5.text: That's a real waste. It pulls you in from the first sentence. Leaving it buried in a drawer is cheating.

after3_yuna_correct_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_6.text: It doesn't deserve that much praise. The writing gets shakier the further you go. *Yuna sets the notebook down and smooths the crumpled corner of the cover with her palm.*

after3_yuna_correct_7.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_7.text: *Yuna steps half a step closer and tugs the sleeve of my uniform shirt with her fingertips.* If you're that curious, should I lend it only to you?

after3_yuna_correct_8.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_8.text: You'll really lend it? Without even asking the original author?

after3_yuna_correct_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_9.text: I'll say the author wanted you, at least, to read it.

after3_yuna_correct_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_10.text: Now that I'm actually putting it in your hands, my heart's loud. Don't ever show it to anyone else. *Yuna holds out the notebook and lays her cold palm over the back of my hand.*

after3_yuna_correct_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_11.text: *Even after the notebook is fully in my hands, Yuna doesn't let go. She draws my wrist in and quietly brings it up beside her flushed cheek.*

after3_yuna_correct_12.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_12.text: *Yuna leans in, her hot cheek against my palm, and whispers.* When you've read it through to the last page, leave that writer one anonymous line. Only for her.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *Yuna checks the notebook in my hands once, then taps the seat beside her on the narrow sofa.* Don't open it right here. I shut the door, so talk with me a little longer before you go.
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Third afternoon in the annex reading room. The player apologized for seeing the first page without permission and promised not to read further. Yuna then willingly lent the notebook. The player holds it and has not read the rest. She asked for one anonymous line of feedback after reading. They talk face to face on the sofa.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is self-conscious about trusting someone with her writing. When embarrassed, she may speak of the author as someone else, but she does not withdraw that trust without cause. She continues with brief questions and quiet humor.

after3_reject_for_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon, met in the hall, wears a faint smile as she lines up the paper corners on her clipboard.*

after3_reject_for_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_2.text: The student council meeting looks like it'll run long today. Don't worry about it. Go on ahead.

after3_reject_for_dain_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3.text: *On the annex table, no note, and no sign of Yuna's bag. Where she sat, only the round water ring from a takeout cup remains, still lukewarm.*

after3_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_1.text: *On the empty gym court, Dain is practicing jump serves. The moment she lands, her right knee buckles and her body tips hard toward the floor.*

after3_dain_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_4.text: *Dain smooths her face on reflex and springs up.* Ah, you scared me! When did you come in? I'm fine. My step just got a little crossed and I twisted it.

after3_dain_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_5.text: Your leg gave out when you landed just now. You don't look fine at all.

after3_dain_5_b.name: Dain
after3_dain_5_b.text: Come on. If you play volleyball, this much is normal. I'm really fine.

after3_dain_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_6.text: *Only after she finishes sounding casual does Dain, short of breath, burst out a big laugh a beat late.*

after3_dain_choice.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice.text: *Perched on the bench in the corner of the court, Dain's palm keeps rubbing the right knee showing under her gym shorts.*
choices: I knew you were pushing it. Drop the tournament and rest today.
Then I'll stay here. Talk when you're ready.
I’ll decide for you so you don’t overdo it.
Don’t worry. I’ll keep an eye on you from now on.

after3_dain_pity_trap_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_1.text: *The hand rubbing her knee stops dead. She looks up at me, and her eyes have gone cold.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_2.text: I overdid it? You're telling me to give up the tournament?

after3_dain_pity_trap_3.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_3.text: Hey. Why are you saying it like it's nothing? I told you I wasn't overdoing it. Just now, my jump form got shaky. That's it.

after3_dain_pity_trap_4.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_4.text: *Dain roughly grabs her sports bag and stands. The moment her weight lands on her right leg, she clenches her molars.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_5.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_5.text: Please. Don't you look at me like that too.

after3_dain_pity_trap_6.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_6.text: Like what? What did I do?

after3_dain_pity_trap_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_7.text: The face they make in the nurse's office. The coach, too. That pitying look, like they're staring at a finished player.

after3_dain_pity_trap_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_8.text: Just go back. Practice is over for me today too, so I'm leaving. *Dain walks toward the door, dragging her right sneaker heavily.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_9.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_9.text: I don't care who else says it. Hearing you tell me to give up is the last thing I ever wanted.

after3_dain_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_10.text: *The metal gym door closes heavily. On the empty bench, only the sweat-soaked wrist guard Dain didn't manage to take is left.*

after3_dain_correct_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_1.text: *Still unable to take her hand off the swollen knee she's holding, Dain looks at me with startled eyes.*

after3_dain_correct_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_2.text: *Dain turns to look at me.* Hey.

after3_dain_correct_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_4.text: You really throw a person off.

after3_dain_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_5.text: Is weird a good thing, or a bad thing?

after3_dain_correct_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_6.text: *Dain gives a weak laugh and lowers her head.* I don't know. I'm confused too. But stay next to me a little longer. I really hate being left alone in this huge gym right now.

after3_dain_correct_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_7.text: If you just stand there, I have to keep looking up at you. Come here and sit. *Dain shifts inward on the bench to make room and rolls the volleyball at her feet off the court.*

after3_dain_correct_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_8.text: *The moment I sit beside her, Dain's hot shoulder presses flush against my arm.* Let's just talk about anything.

after3_dain_correct_10.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_10.text: I never complain to anyone. Ever. So I can't even open my mouth about where to start.

after3_dain_correct_11.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_11.text: If I just sit still, it's bearable. *Dain tries to stretch her right leg, then catches her breath at the pain and clutches the hem of my shirt.*

after3_dain_correct_12.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_12.text: Dain, will you be straight with me and start with your knee?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell.text: *Dain, forehead on my shoulder as she steadies her short breath, flinches.* What?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.text: Your right knee. It's been on my mind since you were running at the gate this morning, and you've been rubbing it this whole time. This isn't just a quick twist from today, is it?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.text: *Instead of answering, Dain tightens the hand gripping my shirt and bites her lip in small bites.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.text: You already caught all of it. Why say it out loud? You know next week is the spring tournament prelims.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.text: Because a knee that lets you keep playing volleyball matters way more than next week's tournament.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.text: What matters more is for me to decide. I'm the player. Not you.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.text: My hands are shaking so much I can't tie the laces right. Don't decide for me just because you saw me like this. *Hand still on her knee, Dain lowers her head into my arms.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_8.text: *Her trembling voice sounds right against my chest.* Please. I'm begging you. Don't say a word about my knee. Not to the coach. Not to the school nurse.

after3_dain_dilemma_final.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_final.text: I'm not messing around like usual. I don't even have the strength left to laugh it off. Answer me. Say you'll promise. *Without a thought of wiping her wet eyes, Dain looks up at me, desperate.*
choices: Sorry. But I'm telling.
Okay. You tell them yourself. But I'm going to the nurse's office with you.
I’ll explain it to the teacher. You just rest.
If you keep hesitating, it’d be better if I told them first.

after3_dain_tell_confirm.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_confirm.text: *Dain's hand, still gripping my shirt, falls away cold.* You really are the worst.

after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.text: *Dain slings her sports bag on roughly and leaves without looking back even once. The gym's iron door slams shut hard enough to numb my ears.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.text: *Dain's limping footsteps fade past the closed door. Left alone on the empty court, the shoulder where her warmth had been goes cold in an instant.*

after3_dain_tell_retreat.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_retreat.text: *Dain lets out the breath she was holding and drops her forehead against my shoulder.* For real. You'll wait until I make up my mind and say it myself?

after3_dain_choice1.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1.text: *Instead of pressing for an answer, I quietly retie Dain's loose shoelace and sit beside her again. Dain looks quietly at the side of my face.*

after3_dain_choice1_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_2.text: Why aren't you asking when it started hurting?

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: You said when you were ready, you'd tell me first.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: You mean I should say it when I'm ready. Not dump it all right now. *Dain bites her lip, then rubs her wet eyes with the back of her hand and smiles.*

after3_dain_choice1_react2.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react2.text: Thanks. If you'd pushed me just now, I would've gotten stubborn again and lied that I was fine.

after3_dain_choice1_react3.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react3.text: *Dain gently rests her warm fingers over the back of my hand on the bench.* When I go down to the nurse's office… stay with me, at least as far as the door.

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *Dain reties her wrist guard and leans in close toward me. Under her reddened eyes, that familiar mischief comes back half a beat late.* Thanks for waiting. This time I'll talk first.
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Third afternoon, on a gym bench. Dain admitted her right knee still hurts. The player agreed to wait for her to speak instead of deciding for her. She asked for company when she visits the infirmary. No examination or competition decision has happened yet. They are sitting and talking face to face.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic and straightforward volleyball player. Humor and sincerity can both appear naturally as she expresses what she feels and what she wants to know about the relationship.

after3_dain_end.name: Dain
after3_dain_end.text: *Dain makes a fist like usual and taps it against my shoulder, but instead of shoving me off like yesterday, only a warm heat stays.*

after3_dain_end_first.name: Dain
after3_dain_end_first.text: *Dain lightly taps my shoulder with her fist, then, a little shy, shoves her hand into the pocket of her practice clothes.*

after3_confront_1.name: {name}
after3_confront_1.text: *When I step into the hallway after class, Seoyeon is waiting in the shade by the window with her arms crossed. Her long fingers tap steadily against her forearm.*

after3_confront_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_2.text: {name}. Don't just go. Look at me for a second.

after3_confront_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_3.text: *Seoyeon leads me to the empty landing at the far end of the hall, away from the other students' eyes.*

after3_confront_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_4.text: The weekend plans that came up at lunch today.

after3_confront_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_5.text: When I found out you smiled at Dain and Yuna with the same warmth and made plans with them too, I felt pathetic. I'd gotten excited, thinking I was the only special one.

after3_confront_5_b.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_b.text: *Dain comes up from below the stairs, a hand on the rail, and cuts in low.* Same for me. Honestly, I was really upset.

after3_confront_5_c.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_c.text: When I said let's meet this weekend, I wasn't joking. Don't brush this moment off as a joke. *Dain presses the toe of her sneaker hard into the landing floor.*

after3_confront_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_6.text: Why couldn't you explain a single thing at lunch? You booked several people into the same weekend. How were you going to handle that?

after3_confront_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_choice.text: Don't dodge it this time. Say it straight, yourself. We can't settle it for you. *In the choking silence, Seoyeon steps back half a pace and glares into my eyes.*
choices: Admit it honestly
The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit.text: So in the end, you couldn't say no because you didn't want anyone to hate you.

after3_confront_admit_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_b.text: *Seoyeon lowers her head and looks coldly down at only the lunch-bag handle in her hand.*

after3_confront_admit_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_2.text: *A clear sheen gathers at the corners of Seoyeon's eyes.* More than a sorry that works as an excuse, I want to hear how you're going to answer for those overlapping plans.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_3.text: Did you think I'd understand and let it go after one apology? I asked what was happening with our plans for this weekend. *Seoyeon squeezes the bag handle hard.*

after3_confront_admit_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4.text: You didn't want to be the bad person, so you dumped the choice on us. That isn't kindness. It's cowardly.

after3_confront_admit_4_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4_b.text: *Seoyeon turns away quickly so her tears won't show and grabs the hall door handle.*

after3_confront_admit_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_5.text: I won't leave the rooftop door open tonight. Don't come up.

after3_confront_excuse.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse.text: *Seoyeon's voice cuts sharp through the air on the landing.* You still think this is about how you split your time?

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It isn't about whether you have the energy to meet that many people. I'm angry that a plan with me weighed that little to you.

after3_confront_excuse_2_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2_b.text: *Seoyeon bites her lip hard, swallowing what she was about to say, and pulls the clipboard against her chest.*

after3_confront_lie_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie_b.text: {name}, don't look away. Look me in the eye and say it. *Seoyeon lowers the clipboard that was covering her chest.*

after3_confront_lie.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie.text: *Seoyeon's voice trembles, thin.* Really, only me? I can believe what you just said, right?

after3_confront_lie_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *Seoyeon turns and walks to the end of the hall before she hears my answer through. The veins on the back of the hand gripping the clipboard never ease.*

after3_confront_end.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_end.text: *Seoyeon walks off toward the end of the empty hall as the sunset cools. Past her rigid back, only her finely trembling fist stays caught in my eyes.*

after3_group_teacher_companion.name: Homeroom Teacher
after3_group_teacher_companion.text: *On the teacher's desk in the classroom with the windows open, a stack of literary-festival manuscripts sits beside papers from another division.* Even one side is tight to finish before sunset. Whose work do you want to help with first?
after3_group_teacher_companion.context: After school, the protagonist is reviewing a draft for a public school literature event with the homeroom teacher in an open classroom when the other character with the highest affinity joins them with separate event materials or a request. There is only enough time to finish one task, so the teacher asks whose work the protagonist will help with first.
after3_group_teacher_companion.personality: The teacher keeps professional distance while guiding the discussion with dry humor and precise notes. Let the companion contribute real opinions through their own voice and interests. Do not turn this into a private teacher-student relationship or a closed-door meeting.
after3_group_teacher_companion.groupChoiceState: the protagonist must say whether to help with the teacher's literature-event draft or the companion's request first
after3_group_teacher_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the open classroom, and why

after3_group_nurse_companion.name: School Nurse
after3_group_nurse_companion.text: *On the desk in the nurse's office, the sports-club health checklist and the emergency-supply box sit side by side.* Both need checking before I leave today, and the times overlap. Which one should we start with?
after3_group_nurse_companion.context: After school in the nurse's office, the protagonist is helping the school nurse organize athletic health checks when the other character with the highest affinity arrives with an urgent supply problem. There is only time to begin with one task, so the nurse asks whose work the protagonist will handle first.
after3_group_nurse_companion.personality: The nurse may ease tension with a light joke, but she never uses care or treatment as an excuse for affection. The companion reacts to the health check or supplies according to their own personality and current condition. Do not inflate routine work into an accident or a secret meeting.
after3_group_nurse_companion.groupChoiceState: the protagonist must say whether to handle the nurse's health check or the companion's supply problem first
after3_group_nurse_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the nurse's office, and why

after3_group_return.name: {name}
after3_group_return.text: *After helping with the work that was left, I step out into the hall as it darkens.*

after3_final.name: {name}
after3_final.text: *The long after-school hours are over. The fluorescent lights on the hall ceiling go out, one by one.*

minsu_d3_1.name: {name}
minsu_d3_1.text: *On the way out of school, Minsu stands in front of a gate pillar with dusk settled on it, his bag on.*

minsu_d3_2.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_2.text: Hey. I saw all of it earlier.

minsu_d3_3.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_3.text: The mood in class at lunch, and Seoyeon's face just now, walking out of the hall.

minsu_d3_5.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5.text: It's getting hard to watch as your friend. All three of them are sincere with you. I know you don't mean any harm, but you keep dodging the chance to say no.

minsu_d3_5b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5b.text: *Minsu folds the straw wrapper he pulled from his empty drink carton, creasing it small between his fingers.*

minsu_d3_6.name: {name}
minsu_d3_6.text: You're right. I've got nothing to say.

minsu_d3_6b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_6b.text: I won't dig into what happened at your school before you transferred. But as your friend, I'll say exactly one thing.

minsu_d3_7.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_7.text: Saying no on time is courtesy, and it's consideration. Drawing a clear line now hurts less than leaving room on a promise you can't keep.

minsu_d3_8.name: {name}
minsu_d3_8.text: *At my old school, too, I always shut my mouth at the moment that mattered. I saw the graffiti on Sojeong's desk and still turned my head. This time I can't dress my cowardly silence up as consideration.*

minsu_d3_9.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_9.text: *Minsu stops talking and shoves the small folded straw wrapper into his uniform pocket.*

minsu_d3_10.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_10.text: See you in the classroom tomorrow morning. Tonight, don't run. Think about it seriously.

haeun_warn_1.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1.text: *At the end of the first-floor hall down toward the gate, someone stands alone by the window where the shadows stretch long, waiting for me.*

haeun_warn_1_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_1_b.text: *Haeun leans her back against the window frame and anxiously fidgets with the student council bracelet on her wrist.*

haeun_warn_2_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_2_b.text: Haeun? Why are you still waiting here? You haven't left?

haeun_warn_3.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_3.text: Senior, did you just come from seeing Seoyeon in the student council room?

haeun_warn_3_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_3_b.text: *Haeun's voice sinks low.* Seoyeon was crying by herself earlier.

haeun_warn_3_c.name: {name}
haeun_warn_3_c.text: *My heart drops. Had she been crying since before I even went into the student council room?*

haeun_warn_4.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_4.text: I ran into her in the girls' bathroom behind the student council room. She brushed it off and said something got in her eye, but anyone could see she'd been crying for a while.

haeun_warn_4b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_4b.text: Seoyeon cried alone in the bathroom?

haeun_warn_5.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5.text: *Haeun checks both ends of the empty hall once, then steps half a pace closer and lowers her voice further.*

haeun_warn_5b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_5b.text: She told me not to ask anything and to leave first. But she stayed at the sink with the cold water running and couldn't come out for a long time.

haeun_warn_5c.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5c.text: *Without thinking, I look back toward the student council room down the hall, and the stairs by the bathroom.*

haeun_warn_6.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6.text: If I follow her now, I'm just her junior. She'll put on that perfect president face again and only say she's fine. But she might listen if it's you, Senior {name}.

haeun_warn_6_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6_b.text: *Haeun turns the student council bracelet on her wrist inward and grips it tight.*

haeun_cheer_1.name: Haeun
haeun_cheer_1.text: *Haeun takes her hand off the bracelet and meets my eyes.* Seoyeon's expression only changes like that when she talks about you, sunbae. I'm really rooting for both of you. I hope you'll stay by her side and comfort her.

haeun_cheer_choice.name: Haeun
haeun_cheer_choice.text: *Haeun smiles, small and faint.* I hope Seoyeon can smile easily again, like she used to. If you're in the seat beside her, Senior, I couldn't ask for more. Just remember there's one junior cheering from behind.
choices: I'll look after Seoyeon first. Don't worry.
Thanks, but this isn't your problem.
Thanks. Seoyeon would want to hear that too.
Nod, then look away

haeun_cheer_up.name: Haeun
haeun_cheer_up.text: *Only then does the tension leave Haeun's stiff shoulders.* That's a relief. Then I'll trust you with today, Senior, and watch quietly.

haeun_cheer_down.name: Haeun
haeun_cheer_down.text: *Haeun bites her lip lightly and lowers her head.* I understand. I'm sorry if I stepped over the line. I still needed to say this.

haeun_warn_7.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7.text: I know I'm meddling in someone else's business. Even so, tonight, please don't pretend you didn't see Seoyeon and leave her.

haeun_warn_7_c.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_c.text: If she pushes you away and says she wants to be alone right now, please wait a little. But later, could you check that she got home safely tonight?

haeun_freetalk.name: Haeun
haeun_freetalk.text: *Haeun doesn't leave. She looks straight up into my eyes.* I'll go once I've heard your answer clearly, Senior. What are you going to do from here?
haeun_freetalk.context: Haeun has seen Seoyeon crying. She asks the player to respect Seoyeon’s wish for space and check later that she got home. They are still in the hallway, where Haeun wants to hear the player’s intentions; she is not asking them to return immediately or ignore a refusal.
haeun_freetalk.personality: Haeun remains polite but will not brush aside the fact that Seoyeon was hurt. She wants to hear what the protagonist will do now rather than an excuse. She may question or challenge his answer, but she does not decide Seoyeon's feelings for her or force the protagonist to perform an action. Do not turn the exchange romantic or sexual. Her affinity represents only personal trust and regard and affects no ending.

haeun_affinity_high_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_high_1.text: *Haeun studies my face seriously for a while, then straightens the student council bracelet that had twisted around to the inside of her wrist.* I'll believe what you said, senior.

haeun_affinity_high_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_high_2.text: Even if Seoyeon says she's fine out of habit, please ask her one more time today. The closer she is to falling apart, the more she acts like nothing's wrong.

haeun_affinity_neutral_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_neutral_1.text: *Haeun keeps her fingers on the bracelet clasp and slowly nods.* Honestly, I still don't believe everything you say, senior.

haeun_affinity_neutral_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_neutral_2.text: Even so, please keep the promise you just made in front of me. And later tonight, please make sure Seoyeon got home safely.

haeun_affinity_low_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_low_1.text: *Haeun clutches the bracelet tight and takes a wary half-step back.* With an attitude like this, it'd be hard to leave Seoyeon with you, senior {name}.

haeun_affinity_low_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_low_2.text: I'll tell the faculty adviser about Seoyeon myself. Even if you run into her, don't say anything that hurts her more.

haeun_warn_8.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8.text: *After Haeun leaves, I knock carefully on the student council room door. A faint scraping of a chair comes from the other side.* Seoyeon, it's me. I'll stay outside a moment, then go.

haeun_warn_8b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8b.text: *I walked out past the school gate as the dark started to settle.*

after3_walk_home.name: {name}
after3_walk_home.text: *Today I don't trust myself to say anything careless to anyone. I put the heavy phone deep in my bag and trudge toward the gate.*

after3_rival_seo_high.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_high.text: *Seoyeon stops at the fork in the hallway. She quietly checks which way I'm headed, then adjusts her grip on her bag strap.* So you're going the other way today.

after3_rival_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_mid.text: Okay. I'll finish what's left in the council room on my own.

after3_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_high.text: *Dain swallows what she was about to say and glances at the sign toward the gym.* You're stopping somewhere else today? Yeah, okay.

after3_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_mid.text: Okay! Then I'll head to the gym first and warm up.

after3_rival_yuna_high.name: Yuna
after3_rival_yuna_high.text: *Yuna closes the book she was about to open, without a sound.* So you're going to someone else today. Yeah. Okay.

after3_rival_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
after3_rival_yuna_mid.text: Okay. I'll be at the annex.

after3_seo_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_partial_1.text: *When I open the student council room door, Seoyeon is picking a clipboard up off the floor. She quickly wipes under one eye and sets a chair straight.*

after3_seo_partial_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_partial_2.text: I'll sort out how I feel on my own today. In return, don't avoid me tomorrow.

after3_seo_low_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_low_1.text: *Seoyeon opens the student council room door only halfway and steps out into the hallway.* I don't think we're at the point of meeting alone after school yet. Let's say the weekend plans never happened.

after3_yuna_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_partial_1.text: *The annex door is open, but Yuna doesn't open her notebook. She looks down once at the chair across from her, the one that used to be my seat, then pushes it under the desk.*

after3_yuna_partial_2.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_partial_2.text: Let's stop here today. If I want to talk next time, I'll come find you first.

after3_yuna_low_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_low_1.text: *In front of the annex door, Yuna adjusts her bag on her shoulder.* Meeting alone like this is still a bit much. This weekend, I'd rather just be by myself.

after3_dain_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_partial_1.text: *On the gym bench, Dain adjusts the brace on her right knee. She sees me and starts to stand, then drops back onto the bench.*

after3_dain_partial_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_partial_2.text: If I sit and rest a bit, I'll be fine. Don't worry about me today. Go on ahead. See you in class tomorrow.

after3_dain_low_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_low_1.text: *Dain keeps hold of the gym door handle and doesn't tell me to come in.* Let's go out just the two of us after we're closer. I'll practice on my own this weekend.

minsu_d3_4_established.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4_established.text: Honestly, it's looked shaky since yesterday. One person at lunch, then someone else after school. But after the mess at lunch today, this isn't something you can just let slide.

minsu_d3_4_first.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4_first.text: Until yesterday I figured you'd handle it, so I kept quiet. But what blew up at lunch today is hard to just look past.

after3_seo_overcare_react.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_overcare_react.text: *Seoyeon's face goes cold.* You'll understand even the weak parts and look after me? What I just asked for wasn't pity. It was for you to treat me like you usually do.

after3_yuna_control_react.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_control_react.text: *Yuna tucks the notebook deeper into her arms.* These are my sentences, and this is my notebook. Who gets to see it, and who keeps it, is my call. Not yours.

after3_dain_control_react.name: Dain
after3_dain_control_react.text: *Dain's eyes narrow, sharp.* Why are you stepping in to decide for me? I never asked you to watch me like you're keeping guard.

after3_rival_seo_cool.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_cool.text: Looks like the after-school plans changed. *Seoyeon turns a page on her clipboard and walks past without stopping.*

after3_rival_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_neg.text: *She goes into the student council room with only the roll pressed tight against her arm. In the end, she never calls my name.*

after3_rival_dain_cool.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_cool.text: So you're skipping the gym today. *Dain resettles the volleyball bag on her shoulder and turns away.*

after3_rival_dain_neg.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_neg.text: *She snatches up the volleyball that rolled across the floor and turns away first, without a hello.*

after3_rival_yuna_cool.name: Yuna
after3_rival_yuna_cool.text: *Yuna closes the annex door quietly, without leaving a single note.*

after3_rival_yuna_neg.name: {name}
after3_rival_yuna_neg.text: *The corner seat in the annex is already empty. The bookmark she used to tuck in, the pale purple note, not a trace of either.*

after3_seo_neg_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_neg_1.text: *She locks the student council room door and puts the key in her pocket.* That's all for today. Don't bring up the weekend plans, either.

after3_yuna_neg_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_neg_1.text: *She clicks off the desk lamp in the annex.* I'm not meeting anyone today. I'll be on my own.

after3_dain_neg_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_neg_1.text: *She winds the volleyball net cord tight and slings her bag over her shoulder.* Go without me today. And don't call me out, either.
